description: This file is a shell script for platform-specific upgrade procedures in the OpenWrt firmware project. It defines functions to check the firmware image and perform upgrades based on board types.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is suitable for the specific board, particularly verifying U-Boot version in the bootloader partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process tailored for specific board models, executing different commands based on board type.
